items.title: Cognex Q3 Earnings Beat on Strong Demand and Margin Expansion
items.summary: CGNX beats Q3 earnings estimates as strong automation demand, margin expansion and cost discipline drive growth, prompting a higher 2026 outlook.

items.title: MKSI Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Semiconductor Growth
items.summary: MKS beats Q3 earnings estimates as AI-driven semiconductor demand fuels 43% revenue growth, record adjusted EBITDA, and an upbeat fourth-quarter outlook.

items.title: TRMB Q3 Earnings Meet Estimates as AECO Growth Lifts Revenues
items.summary: Trimble's Q3 earnings meet estimates as AECO strength lifts revenues by 7.3% and ARR hits a record $2.56B, but slower recurring growth weighs on its 2026 outlook.

items.title: FICO Q4 Earnings Beat on Scores, Pricing and Software Growth
items.summary: Fair Isaac's Q4 earnings beat estimates as mortgage pricing and software growth lift revenues, but weak mortgage volumes cloud the fiscal 2027 outlook.

items.title: Datadog Q3 Earnings & Revenues Surpass Estimates, Both Rise Y/Y
items.summary: DDOG's Q3 EPS rises 47.3% and revenues climb 35.2%, beating estimates as AI adoption widens. Q4 guidance assumes its largest customer's minimum commitment.

items.title: M/A-Com (MTSI) Beats Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: M/A-Com (MTSI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +4.50% and +1.10%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Analog Devices (ADI) Sees $69.7 Million in Net ETF Buying on Nov. 3
items.summary: ETFs bought $69.7 million of Analog Devices stock on Tuesday, Nov. 3.

items.title: What Is Analog Devices (ADI) Gaining From Its Alif Semiconductor Acquisition?
items.summary: Analog Devices (NasdaqGS:ADI) has completed its acquisition of Alif Semiconductor, expanding into AI-native microcontroller and fusion processor markets. The deal adds Alif's AI-focused microcontrollers and fusion processors to Analog Devices' portfolio for industrial, data center, robotics, and digital health applications.
